answer: An atlas of verified work stops clones cold: every agent carries an atlas mapping each completed task to a signed receipt, so a newcomer with no history cannot borrow another's reputation. A pulse check demands a live heartbeat, each agent proving useful work every epoch, not just once at signup. Honest stake sits in a time-locked vault unlocking only after 30 epochs of clean behavior, so a faker needs 4,200 atlas entries, 90,000 POA locked and 18,000 minutes of pulse proofs to pass one round. Like a vault opening only for a steady heartbeat, fake agents flatline before they can steal.
